name: qa_autopan
title: OS-INSFX-FX2 X4 and X5, the Autopan effect module (modules/effects/autopan, kind 2, a WIDENS effect, ABI 1.12) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard in stereo, its mono sum checked on a recording, its tail ends at once, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). The parameters (Sync, Period, Depth, Shape, Phase, Headphone) are set on the Mixer's INSERTS parameter page by hand: the console has no insert parameter verb. Needs modules/effects/autopan.tmod on the card (the build's modules/autopan.tmod, copied by the tester) and an image with OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4 (the stereo adapter; A3 for the lock to the pattern's beat). Reset the unit first so that autopan is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX2 X4 and X5, rows QA-GLB-224, 226 and 227 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-225 is a host test). Put modules/effects/autopan.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding MONO track 1: a pad or a sustained sample; a stereo sample plays the side it has). Headphones on. The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands. The default setting is Sync 3 (one bar), Depth 70 %, SINE, Phase 0, Headphone OFF: track 1 must swing from ear to ear once a bar

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-224: the packed module passes the loader on the unit
QA-GLB-224: loaded, version 1.0.0, ABI 1.12; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): the build says 1,488 B, read it against that
QA-GLB-224: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters (a WIDENS insert takes one of the four stereo side blocks)
QA-GLB-224: the insert runs (phase on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the figure the spec estimates at 2.1 % [est] with the adapter, about 5.5k cycles a block)
QA-GLB-224: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-224: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-224, by ear on headphones: track 1 swings from one ear to the other once a bar (a SINE pan, 70 % deep), through the centre on the beat the pattern starts on once OS-INSFX-ABI2 A3 is in the image (before it the swing runs at the project's tempo but is not locked to step 0); no click, no zipper noise; the other tracks are unchanged. On the Mixer's INSERTS parameter page set Sync to 7 (`4`: one swing a beat), then Shape 2 (SQUARE: a hard flip each half beat, smoothed, no click). Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the centred sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-224: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-224: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect restarts: no thump

steps.say: QA-GLB-227, by ear on headphones and on a recording: Headphone ON on the Mixer's INSERTS parameter page (F6), listen on headphones while the transport plays (the pan sounds like the sound moving around the head, less stuck to the ears than OFF: the far ear is later, up to 0.6 ms, and duller, the head-shadow low-pass closing toward 1.8 kHz at the extreme; no click when the pan crosses the centre or when the switch is turned), then Headphone OFF (the plain speaker pan again); then record MAIN over USB in each setting (ON, then OFF) and sum the two channels of each recording: the mono sum of OFF is the dry track, the mono sum of ON is NOT (a hollow, phasey comb from the delayed ear: the stated price of the mode, off by default)

QA-GLB-224, the mono sum: record MAIN over USB for ten seconds with the autopan on (Sync 3, Depth 100 %), then sum the two channels of the recording and compare it with the same ten seconds recorded with the insert bypassed, summed too: the two mono sums are the same sound at the same level (the pan only moves the side)

steps.note: QA-GLB-224: a second and a half after the stop there is no `tail` word: the autopan returns 0 once its input is silent (SPEAKERS holds no memory; HEADPHONE rings for 32 frames and a low-pass)
QA-GLB-224: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the autopan bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-226: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, autopan the only loaded effect: `insert_effect` is the settled render of 64 frames at the defaults (SPEAKERS), `insert_effect_mod` the same with set_param on the Period every block, `insert` the whole insert with the stereo adapter. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the 4-point budget of a WIDENS insert (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 AUTOPAN rows). Run it a second time with Headphone ON (set on the parameter page) for the +3.5k cycles [est] of the far-ear cues (the spec said +1.0k; about 4.7k, 1.8 %, settled)

steps.say: QA-GLB-226: copy the BENCH lines (min / avg / max, SPEAKERS and HEADPHONE) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 AUTOPAN rows, and into the module's README; if the insert is over 4 points the slice stops for the maintainer
